issue.body:
### Description

In the guide, [Quarkus - Using Apache Kafka with Reactive Messaging guide](https://quarkus.io/guides/kafka), there is a section on "Authentication with OAuth", where a third party library, the strimzi-kafka-oauth client, is specified to provide the jaas callback handler. The problem is that this library is not part of Quarkus and is not guaranteed to work, for example, in native mode. In fact versions 0.8.0+ currently cause native app builds to fail (see [kafka-oauth-client supported for use with Quarkus (native)?](https://github.com/strimzi/strimzi-kafka-oauth/issues/122) in strimzi-kafka-oauth). (This is an issue for the guide, but it is also a more general problem of how to handle this dependency.) In that issue it was pointed out that it is the responsibility of Quarkus to ensure that libs such as this work in conjunction with Quarkus, and therefore it should add explicitly as a dependency and tested as part of Quarkus.

I am suggested adding this lib as a separate Quarkus extension that can be optionally added to enable Oauth for kafka; however, it might make more sense to add it to the "bom" with some tests to ensure that it works correctly, as I think is being suggested here: #18601 and #18605. I defer to your wisdom on this point.

Thanks!

Interested in this extension, please +1 via the emoji/reaction feature of GitHub (top right).
